goal: Navigate to https://amazon.in to complete the goal: You are testing whether an AI agent can complete a real customer journey on this website. Journey: Find how to exchange a product for a different size: open help, find the returns or exchange policy, read the rules and reach the page where an exchange is requested. Never pay, place an order, create an account, or press a final Send, Submit, Apply, Book or Confirm button. Stop at the first page that asks for payment details or a final confirmation, with that button visible. If a form needs details, type only fake test data: name 'Test Agent', email test@example.com, phone 9999999999. Close cookie banners and popups and continue. Do not sign in. If the site asks you to sign in, stop on that page and report it. Milestones in order: help_opened, returns_found, exchange_rules_read, request_page_reached. Set furthest_milestone to the last one you truly completed. Set outcome to 'success' if you reached every milestone you were allowed to reach, 'partial' if some, otherwise 'failure'. Set blocker to the single main obstacle, or 'none', and explain it in blocker_detail. Fill item_name, item_price, coupon_code, discount and total when they apply.

result.answer: Milestones completed: 1) help_opened - Yes, accessed Customer Service help page. 2) returns_found - Yes, found Returns, Refunds, Replacement section with relevant links. 3) exchange_rules_read - Yes, read about the exchange policy: customers can exchange items for different sizes/colors subject to availability within 10 days of delivery, items must be in original condition with tags/packaging. 4) request_page_reached - No, blocked by sign-in wall. The Returns Centre redirected to a login page requiring email/mobile number entry. Per task instructions, the agent stopped on the sign-in page and did not proceed with fake credentials. No payment details or final confirmation buttons were reached.
result.blocker_detail: After successfully navigating through all milestones up to exchange_rules_read (opened help, found returns/exchange policy, and read the exchange rules including the 10-day free exchange policy for different sizes), the Returns Centre page redirected to a sign-in/login wall. Amazon.in requires authentication to access the exchange request form, which blocked progression to the request_page_reached milestone.
